model.title: National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Act of 2025
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Ed Case (D-HI)

summary.text: The bill would establish a formal program authorizing regional teams within the National Wildlife Refuge System to coordinate with public and private partners in addressing invasive species that threaten the environment, human health, or the economy. It would also require the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to report to Congress on the program's progress and outcomes.
